articles.title: Mengapa website Astro memakai snapshot konten Strapi
articles.summary: CI tidak bisa mengakses Strapi di laptop. Snapshot JSON membuat build tetap otomatis tanpa server CMS online.
articles.content:
Untuk portofolio Aksara, Strapi tetap lokal. Website dibangun dari file JSON hasil export supaya GitHub Actions tidak bergantung pada mesin pengembang yang menyala.

Saat pengembangan lokal, Astro masih boleh membaca Strapi langsung. Yang penting: kontrak data antara CMS dan halaman tetap sama.

seo.metaDescription: Alasan memakai snapshot JSON agar CI bisa build website tanpa Strapi online.

articles.title: Why the Astro site uses a Strapi content snapshot
articles.summary: CI cannot reach Strapi on a laptop. A JSON snapshot keeps builds automated without an online CMS.
articles.content:
For the Aksara portfolio, Strapi stays local. The website builds from exported JSON so GitHub Actions does not depend on a developer machine being online.

During local development, Astro may still read Strapi directly. The important part is that the data contract between CMS and pages stays the same.

seo.metaDescription: Why a JSON snapshot lets CI build the site without an online Strapi instance.
